name: Allow with NotAction iam:* on * (broad, but grants NO IAM administration)
note: NotAction Allow grants every action EXCEPT the listed ones. Excluding iam:* means this statement does not grant any IAM action, even though it is otherwise extremely broad.
rationale: An Allow statement with NotAction lists the actions the Allow does NOT apply to; it grants everything else. With NotAction iam:*, every IAM action is excluded, so this statement grants zero IAM permissions - a DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN finding would be a false positive. The statement is still dangerously broad (it allows nearly all non-IAM actions on all resources), which is exactly what NOTACTION-ALLOW should capture. The engine must flag the breadth WITHOUT fabricating an IAM-administration capability that the exclusion removes. Ref: AWS docs, 'IAM JSON policy elements: NotAction' (NotAction with Allow grants all actions except those listed).
